description: This file is a template only, not applied by any installer; B1 applies no Codex hook. It shows the SessionStart group that would run the native-agent-stack session-start currency notice in Codex (adoption/hooks/claude/currency-due-notice.py, which the Claude profile's guard step installs under ~/.claude/hooks). By hand, append this group after the one SessionStart group already in the user hooks.json in the Codex home (ai-memory's installer writes it): Codex then keys it session_start:1:0; no config-template trust entry is shipped for it, so Codex lists the handler as untrusted until it is reviewed in /hooks. After two or more groups the key is session_start:2:0 or later, and Codex lists the handler as untrusted until it is reviewed in /hooks. Used as is: $HOME is expanded by the shell Codex runs the command in.
